detail.nightYardNote: a yard frame costs the same by night as by day when timed alone (12.5 ms by day, 12.1 ms by night: 44 against 47 draw calls, 330,704 against 333,404 triangles, no shadow pass in either); an earlier day figure of 26 ms was measured while the windows' visitor was still open and drawing, which halves the GPU.
